caption: 01 · REACH — What can the platform do exceptionally well?. Discovery, social proof, conversation, cultural participation, and rapid distribution are real institutional advantages. The audit begins by naming that value rather than treating dependency as failure.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping what can the platform do exceptionally well? within A Million Followers Is a Rented Institution.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 02 · ACCESS — Who can enter and recover the account?. Record the account owner, administrators, authentication method, recovery contacts, device access, and escalation route. A display name or founder face does not prove operational control.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping who can enter and recover the account? within A Million Followers Is a Rented Institution.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 03 · PORTABILITY — What can leave with consent and context?. Map content originals, captions, contacts, customer records, permissions, analytics exports, and conversation history. Preserve only what may lawfully and ethically be retained.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping what can leave with consent and context? within A Million Followers Is a Rented Institution.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 04 · ROUTE — How many ways can the institution reach people?. Build at least one controlled destination and one consent-based contact route. Redundancy should improve continuity without manipulating audiences or copying data beyond its stated purpose.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping how many ways can the institution reach people? within A Million Followers Is a Rented Institution.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
